Projects.title: Healentra
Projects.description:
Healentra – A comprehensive healthcare platform connecting patients and doctors for seamless consultations. The platform is designed to provide real-time, secure, and efficient communication between patients and healthcare providers while allowing admins to manage the ecosystem effectively.

Key Features:

Patient Features:

Book consultations with doctors based on available slots.
Join video consultations via Zoom Video SDK.
Communicate with doctors through audio and text consultations using WebSocket.
View and manage all past and upcoming consultations.
Update and manage their profile information.

Doctor Features:

Set and manage available consultation slots.
Conduct video consultations via Zoom Video SDK.
Communicate with patients in audio or text consultations using WebSocket.
View and manage all consultations.
Purchase subscription plans and cancel them at the end of the subscription period.
Update and manage profile information.
Complete onboarding and receive admin approval before offering consultations.

Admin Features:

Manage all doctors, patients, and consultations on the platform.
Oversee and manage subscription plans.
Update doctor and patient credentials and send notifications via email.
Approve doctors after onboarding is completed.
Projects.technologies: Next.js, Redux, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, JWT, AWS S3, WebSocket, Zoom Video SDK, React big calendar

Projects.title: NoStressMD
Projects.description:
NoStressMD is a digital healthcare platform that provides private, fast, and hassle-free medical services online. It connects users directly with licensed healthcare professionals, enabling personalized prescriptions and medication delivery—either to your door or for pickup at a local pharmacy—without the need for insurance or in-person doctor visits.

NoStressMD focuses on several key areas to make healthcare accessible and convenient:

General Health: Support for everyday wellness and common health concerns.
Men's Health: Personalized treatments for men's specific health needs.
Sexual Health: Discreet and professional care to maintain sexual wellness.
Medications: Easy access to a wide range of non-controlled prescription medications.

How it works: Users select their symptom or medication, complete a simple online form, and a licensed nurse practitioner reviews the information to create a personalized treatment plan. Prescriptions can then be sent to a pharmacy for pickup or delivered the same day in Houston.
Projects.technologies: React.js, Redux Toolkit, JWT, AWS S3, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB

Projects.title: AI Guide: Interactive Lecture Sessions with Virtual Instructors
Projects.description:
AI-Guide is a mobile application that transforms written text into fully lip-synced video lectures using a custom dataset of five Virtual University (VU) speakers. The system integrates voice cloning, text-to-speech, and lip-syncing technologies to generate realistic, speaker-specific educational videos. The deep learning models are fine-tuned on the custom dataset for higher accuracy, and the application runs on Android using Expo Go.

Custom Dataset
The project uses a custom-built dataset consisting of clean audio recordings and front-facing videos of five VU speakers. This dataset enables accurate voice cloning and high-quality lip synchronization.

Project Modules

Voice Cloning & Text-to-Speech
Using Coqui TTS, the system converts any input text into synthetic speech that mimics the selected speaker’s voice. The TTS model is fine-tuned on the custom dataset to improve speaker similarity.

Lip Syncing
Wav2Lip aligns the generated audio with the speaker’s video, producing natural lip-synced output. The model is also fine-tuned for better synchronization on the custom dataset.

Workflow

User enters the text.
The system generates speech using the selected speaker’s cloned voice.
The generated audio is lip-synced with a speaker video.
Optional background replacement can be applied.
The final processed video is available for download.
Projects.technologies: Deep Learning, Python, React Native, Flask, Kaggle Notebook, TTS (Text-to-Speech), Voice Cloning, Lip Syncing (Wav2Lip), Expo Go
